items.title: SHW Q3 deep dive: strong revenue growth meets margin pressures and cautious outlook
items.summary: Paint and coating manufacturer Sherwin-Williams (NYSE:SHW) reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.9% year on year to $6.86 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.63 per share was 1.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 5 revealing analyst questions from Sherwin-Williams’s Q3 earnings call
items.summary: Sherwin-Williams' third quarter results were met with a negative market reaction, primarily due to weaker-than-expected profitability despite sales growth. Management attributed the robust top-line performance to continued market share gains, new account wins, and the impact of recent acquisitions. CEO Heidi Petz acknowledged that the company’s sales-to-earnings conversion fell short of internal standards, citing elevated raw material and supply chain costs as notable challenges.
